prompts.name: before-rename
prompts.title: Before a rename
prompts.description: The calls to make before renaming a symbol, route, channel or type: who calls it, what reaches it, the crossings it is on.

arguments.name: symbol
arguments.description: an id, a name, or a route said aloud, e.g. "POST /orders"

prompts.name: pr-review
prompts.title: Review a branch
prompts.description: Review the branch from the last flowatlas diff: the verdict, its reasons, and the calls that check them.

arguments.name: base
arguments.description: the ref it merges into, e.g. main

prompts.name: trace-route
prompts.title: Trace a route
prompts.description: Trace a way in end to end: its flow, each crossing checked, what the reading could not follow.

arguments.name: route
arguments.description: a way in, e.g. "POST /orders" or an entry id
